What you'll do: We are seeking a motivated Data Engineering Student to join our team! This role will focus on building and optimizing data pipelines, ensuring data quality, and supporting analytics initiatives across the organization: • Design, develop, and maintain ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for large-scale datasets. • Work with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, Hadoop) to manage data storage and processing. • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to ensure data availability and integrity. • Implement data validation and monitoring tools to maintain high-quality datasets. Document workflows and contribute to best practices for data engineering. • Job Requirements What you bring: • Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline • Familiarity with SQL and one programming language (Python, Java, or Scala). • Understanding of data modelling and relational databases. • Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) is an asset. • Strong problem-solving and communication skills. We're always looking for great talent!
